name: Guangdong Dowstone Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Dowstone Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells lithium batteries, carbon, and ceramic materials in China and internationally. The company offers solid state battery materials, such as silicon-carbon anode, single walled carbon nanotube powder/slurry, and solid-state electrolyte; AI intelligent computing products; carbon materials, including single walled carbon, Oligowalled carbon, and multi-walled nanotube powder and conductive pastes, as well as silicon carbon negative electrode; lithium battery materials, such as triple precursor body and cobalt salts; and ceramic materials. Guangdong Dowstone Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Enping, China.
